_comment_region: THE SINGLE BIGGEST PERFORMANCE FIX IN THIS PROJECT.
Without this, Vercel defaults functions to iad1 (Washington DC) while the
Supabase database sits in ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) — about 15,000 km and
~230ms of round-trip latency apart. Every Prisma query pays that toll, and
connection_limit=1 means they run strictly one after another:
/api/auth/login    6 round trips  ->  ~1.4s of pure network wait
Measured before the change: /api/health, which runs a single SELECT 1,
took 1.6-1.7s of server time. The query is trivial; the distance is not.
sin1 (Singapore) puts functions in the same region as the database, cutting
each round trip from ~230ms to single-digit milliseconds. It is also far
closer to users in Bangladesh than Washington DC.
IF THE PRODUCTION DATABASE MOVES, CHANGE THIS. Production currently sits in
ap-northeast-1 (Tokyo), so functions in sin1 still pay ~70ms per query
there. Co-locating both in ap-southeast-1 is the tidier end state; region
must always follow the database, not the users, because one request makes
many database round trips and only one trip to the user.
